spec.name: sprint17_predmarket_spread_scan
spec.hypothesis: Kalshi and Polymarket price matched real-world binary events differently often enough, by enough margin net of fees, to support convergence trades (IMDEA: ~$40M/yr extracted industry-wide; 1.5-4.5% cross-venue spreads documented). Settlement-definition mismatch is the primary confound.
spec.power_argument: T0 tier: mechanism-check/measurement only, never a verdict (CHARTER T0). Target >=300 matched event-pairs (resolution-criteria-text matched, not title-matched) over a 30-day monitoring window across the two venues' open markets; min detectable mean spread at t=2 stated as 50bp gross -- must clear T2-equivalent all-in cost (~10bp/side + settlement risk) before any paper trade is proposed.
symbols: N/A -- prediction-market event tickers, not equities/crypto
